description: Same Padatious engine as padatious-medium, with the plugin's own two-stage DomainIntentContainer switched on via 'domain_engine': true: utterances first route to a skill_id-scoped domain container, then match against that domain's intents only.
notes: Same plugin id and medium-confidence gate as padatious-medium; the only config change is flipping 'domain_engine' from false to true, which swaps the internal IntentContainer for DomainIntentContainer (ovos_padatious/domain_container.py). Hypothesis: domain-first two-stage routing should help precision on large multi-domain intent sets (fewer cross-domain false positives) at the cost of an extra routing step, and be roughly neutral-to-worse on small single-domain sets where there is no domain structure to exploit.
